attrs.title: How do I install the theme?

slots.body: Download the package from your account, unzip it, and upload the folder to your site. The installer walks you through the remaining steps.

slots.name: item

attrs.title: Can I use it on more than one site?

slots.body: A single licence covers one production site plus as many staging environments as you need.

slots.name: item

attrs.title: What happens when my licence expires?

slots.body: Your site keeps working exactly as it is. You simply stop receiving new releases and priority support until you renew.

examples.label: Billing FAQ with five questions
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-accordion" site="Global" id="accordion-support-faq" multiple> <:item id="faq-billing-date" title="When am I billed?">

Subscriptions renew on the same day of each month. The exact date, along with every past invoice, is listed under Billing in your account.

<:item id="faq-plan-change" title="Can I change plans mid-cycle?">

Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately and we charge only the prorated difference. Downgrades take effect at the start of your next cycle.

<:item id="faq-seats" title="How are extra seats charged?">

Every plan includes five seats. Additional seats are $9 each per month and can be added or removed at any time from the Team page.

<:item id="faq-refund" title="Do you offer refunds?">

Annual plans are refunded in full within thirty days of purchase, no questions asked. Monthly plans can be cancelled any time before the next renewal.

<:item id="faq-data-retention" title="What happens to my data if I cancel?">

Your workspace stays readable for sixty days so you can export everything you need. After that it is permanently removed from our systems and backups.

examples.label: Shipping and returns panel on a product page
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-accordion" site="Global" id="accordion-shipping" variant="bordered" color="natural" padding="medium"> <:item id="ship-delivery" icon="hero-truck" title="Delivery" description="Free on orders over $60">

Standard delivery arrives in two to four working days. Express delivery is $9 and arrives the next working day when ordered before 2pm.

<:item id="ship-returns" icon="hero-arrow-uturn-left" title="Returns and exchanges" description="Thirty days, prepaid label">

Send anything back within thirty days for a full refund. Print the prepaid label from your order page, drop the parcel at any collection point, and we refund within five working days of it arriving.

<:item id="ship-warranty" icon="hero-shield-check" title="Two-year warranty" description="Covers manufacturing defects">

Every product is covered for two years against manufacturing defects. Accidental damage is not included, but we offer a discounted replacement in that case.

<.component component_name="chelekom-accordion" site="Global" id="accordion-release-notes" variant="base_separated" space="small" padding="medium"> <:item id="rel-2-4-0" title="Version 2.4.0" description="Released 12 March" open>
  • Draft previews now open in a side panel instead of a new browser tab.
  • Media library uploads resume automatically after a dropped connection.
  • Fixed a case where scheduled posts published an hour early on the daylight-saving changeover.
<:item id="rel-2-3-2" title="Version 2.3.2" description="Released 27 February">
  • Reduced first-paint time on the dashboard by deferring the activity feed.
  • Corrected the ordering of revisions when two edits share a timestamp.
<:item id="rel-2-3-0" title="Version 2.3.0" description="Released 9 February">
  • Added per-site notification preferences for editors and reviewers.
  • Introduced keyboard shortcuts for save, preview, and publish.
